manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity still pulls it downward.
manifest.description: A ball moves vertically on a height scale. A blue motion arrow shows its velocity, while a dashed warm gravity arrow remains constant downward.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
